organs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. This attached kidney battlefield is the edit target. Make ONLY the FLOOR SURFACE TEXTURE richer; all existing geometry is locked. Keep the exact exterior kidney silhouette, notch, framing, transparent background, the current VERY SHALLOW inner rim/depth, and every existing triangular/flower-shaped cover island, its position, size and shadows. Do NOT deepen the bowl or thicken the rim. The currently almost plain pink floor needs a clearly visible but tasteful cute geometric ORGAN-TISSUE GROUND TEXTURE. Paint 3 scales of FLAT color variation: (1) a few broad softly faceted rose/peach ground regions; (2) many medium-sized irregular rounded polygon cortex-cell/lobule patches, each about 1.5-4% of organ width, softly interlocking in a natural non-grid layout; (3) a sparse sprinkling of tiny solid peach/cream/pink chips and short rounded dot clusters. Warm pastel pink/coral/apricot only. Medium patches should differ about 8-14% in value from the local floor, enough to remain visible when zoomed out, yet lower contrast than the raised cover. Use clean crisp 2D cel-shaded vector-like color patches, not blurry watercolor, no gritty noise, no regular hexagonal floor tiling or outlines around every patch. This should read as varied living organ terrain ground, not a blank plate or sandpaper. The FLOOR TEXTURE IS FLAT PAINTED PIGMENT, not extra obstacles, bumps, holes or new height. Keep the central traversal and battle lanes visually clear. Do not change the established simple cute geometric style. Absolutely NO green, leaves/plants, blood vessel lines, tubes, worms, pores, fingers, wet flesh, slime, characters, labels or text. Retain true transparent background. Same exact composition; ONLY add layered subtle but visibly detailed ground texture.
